title: SCA Minhag of the Week 164: "When to add ‘Anenu to the ‘Amidah"

chapters.title: Authorities on Anenu
chapters.about: Rav Amram Gaon, Rif, Ramban, Rashba, Ravinu Zerahyah Levi

chapters.title: Community variations

chapters.title: Geographic customs
chapters.about: Yemen, Tunisia, Jerba, Morocco, Libya, Izmir

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the different customs regarding when to recite the Anenu prayer within the Amidah on fast days. He reviews the sources and historical practices of various communities, including the custom in Aram Soba, regarding whether to include Anenu in the Arbit prayer on the night before a fast.
questions: When is the Anenu prayer added to the Amidah?
Do all communities include Anenu in the Arbit prayer before a fast?
What was the historical custom in Aram Soba regarding Anenu?
Why did some authorities suggest only saying Anenu during Minha?
